## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npm run build` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavioural changes
- [ ] Database schema changes include a committed migration
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or real user data in the diff
- [ ] No user content (diary text, chat messages, images) is written to logs
